import datetime
# Use previously parsed meetings from thread 47821
thread_id = 47821
thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=gmail_token)
body = thread['emails'][0]['body']
import re
pattern=re.compile(r'-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*@\s*([0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2})')
meetings = pattern.findall(body)
print('meetings_parsed', meetings)

day_map = {
    'monday':'monday','tue':'tuesday','tuesday':'tuesday',
    'wednesday':'wednesday','wed':'wednesday',
    'thursday':'thursday','thu':'thursday',
    'friday':'friday','fri':'friday',
    'saturday':'saturday','sat':'saturday',
    'sunday':'sunday','sun':'sunday'
}

def subtract_minutes(hhmm, minutes):
    t = datetime.datetime.strptime(hhmm, '%H:%M')
    t2 = t - datetime.timedelta(minutes=minutes)
    return t2.strftime('%H:%M')

created=[]
for name, day, hhmm in meetings:
    day_key = day.strip().lower()
    repeat_day = day_map.get(day_key)
    if not repeat_day:
        raise ValueError(f'Unrecognized day: {day}')
    alarm_time = subtract_minutes(hhmm, 15)
    res = apis.phone.create_alarm(time=alarm_time, access_token=phone_token, repeat_days=[repeat_day], label=name, snooze_minutes=15)
    created.append(res)
    print('created', res)

print('created_count', len(created))

# Verification: fetch the alarms we just created
created_alarm_ids = [743, 744, 745, 746]
results = []
for aid in created_alarm_ids:
    alarm = apis.phone.show_alarm(alarm_id=aid, access_token=phone_token)
    results.append(alarm)
    print(alarm)
print('verified_count', len(results))

# Complete the supervisor task
result = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
print(result)
